title: Cah Cah: Suara dari Got Keistimewaan Vol. 1
comment: The first zine from Tuesday Louder, a weekly live music initiative from the heart of Yogyakarta. In this debut zine, they share their perspectives on music, the people and the current political climate through a raw and expressive writing style, filled with social frustration and rebellious energy.
